item.title: Caffeine, cocaine, and painkillers detected in sharks from The Bahamas
Zed, A sans for the needs of 21st century (2024)
item.description:
📝 The Text version has increased contrast, 80% of the verticals, which makes text clearer in small sizes. Long text in small point sizes requires sufficient white space around the letters that makes text easy to read. A sans for small text … and large.
🔗 Read more: https://www.typotheque.com/blog/zed-a-sans-for-the-needs-of-21century
